  Use:     placed unmodified in the Harbor Rain outer roads (cruise_ship.glb is used in place).

Container Ship and Liberty Ship are used from extracted copies under
Assets/_NeonRift/Levels/HarborRain/Imported/Ships (see the ATTRIBUTION.txt there). The other ship archives that were
downloaded (a sailing frigate, a science-fiction spacecraft, and a work boat of unknown origin) are not used and are not
in the public repository.
